sql: SELECT f_status AS g0, AVG((julianday(f_viewed_at) - julianday(f_applied_at)) * 24) AS m0, COUNT(*) AS m1, SUM(CASE WHEN ((julianday(f_viewed_at) - julianday(f_applied_at))) <= ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m2, COUNT(*) AS _n, json_group_array(id) AS _ids FROM entities WHERE type = ? AND retracted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(entities.reached) WHERE json_each.value IN (?, ?)) GROUP BY g0 ORDER BY g0
